content.title: 静态人像转义｜微表情改写前段含义
content.summary: 让近静镜头留出观察时间，再用少量可见状态变化改变读法。

quick_start.input_format: 成年主体＋稳定环境＋一个后段可见变化
quick_start.recommended_input: 原创成年跑者，一条雨后空旷终点跑道，灰色跑步夹克，右手攥着一张无品牌号码布；人物和场地保持固定。
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 让近静镜头留出观察时间，再用少量可见状态变化改变读法。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: Hold one stable subject and place almost motionless under a coherent slow camera approach; in the latter portion of the same view, a small coherent sequence of gaze, expression and visible-state changes becomes readable and reframes the preceding stillness. A transfer may deliberately simplify this to one clear cue. Source-specific bilateral tears and styling are excluded.

invariants.rule: Keep one subject and one spatial setting stable through a long near-still hold.
invariants.purpose: Lets the viewer notice a small late difference rather than track changing geography.
invariants.ablation_failure: Rapid location or identity changes consume attention and erase the subtle payoff.

invariants.rule: Use one slow, legible camera approach or progressive reframing while the subject's motion stays smaller than the camera movement.
invariants.purpose: Builds attention without substituting montage spectacle for performance.
invariants.ablation_failure: Abrupt cuts or fast camera motion make a micro-change hard to perceive.

invariants.rule: Reserve a small, coherent visible-state development for the later close view and hold long enough to read it; a transfer may simplify this to one cue.
invariants.purpose: The delayed cue changes how the earlier restraint is interpreted.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the cue occurs early, is invisible, or is replaced by explanatory text, the delayed reinterpretation disappears.

slots.name: subject
slots.constraint: One original stable adult person or clearly designed nonhuman subject; preserve identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: One persistent original space, not the source's ornate room.

slots.name: camera
slots.constraint: One slow approach or tightening frame; no rapid montage.

slots.name: late_state_change
slots.constraint: One original small visible cue, not the source's exact smile-and-tear pairing.

slots.name: palette_medium
slots.constraint: Original visual medium and color design.

slots.name: sound
slots.constraint: Optional original restrained sound timed to the cue; not inferred source audio.

anti_copy_exclusions: Do not copy the source person's face, hair ornaments, costume, luxury setting, pose, lighting palette or bilateral-tears-plus-smile combination.
Do not import creator caption wording, brand/tool credits or the original framing trajectory frame by frame.
Do not treat the source emotion or backstory as known.

instantiations.concept: An adult marathon runner stands nearly still at an empty finish line; a slow approach ends with one hand unclenching to release a crumpled race bib.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Original documentary daylight, one adult runner and one finish-line environment; slow approach, minimal motion, then one legible hand release changes the reading from defeat to relief.

instantiations.concept: A stop-motion maintenance robot holds position in a silent observatory; a slow approach ends when its single chest light changes from amber to green.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Original miniature stop-motion science setting, one consistent nonhuman robot; no source face or jewelry, slow approach and one delayed chest-light state change.

failure_modes.failure: Camera push becomes a fast zoom or cuts away before the cue.
failure_modes.repair: Use one gradual move and hold the late changed state.

failure_modes.failure: The cue is too large or overly literal.
failure_modes.repair: Specify one small filmable motion or object/light change, with no explanatory title.

failure_modes.failure: Identity or environment drifts across a nearly static shot.
failure_modes.repair: Lock the subject's two or three visual anchors and background geography.

transfer_tests.concept: An adult marathon runner stands nearly still at an empty finish line; a slow approach ends with one hand unclenching to release a crumpled race bib.
A stop-motion maintenance robot holds position in a silent observatory; a slow approach ends when its single chest light changes from amber to green.

review.method: Chinese interface editorial pass with canonical English Creative DNA preserved after translation service rate limit
